summary_1line: Devayani, attended by Sarmishtha and many maids, meets King Yayati in the forest and introduces herself, initiating their fateful acquaintance.

image_candidates.scene_text: Devayani reclines in the forest while Sarmishtha kneels to gently massage her feet, surrounded by a thousand maidens adorned with flowers.
King Yayati, dusty and thirsty from the hunt, emerges from the woods and gazes upon Devayani and Sarmishtha among the flower-filled grove.
Devayani proudly introduces herself to Yayati while Sarmishtha stands beside her as a waiting-maid amid two thousand attendants.
